syncErrorNoUpstream: No upstream branch. Set it in terminal
syncErrorDiverged: Branches diverged. Rebase or merge in terminal
syncErrorLocalChanges: Local changes would be overwritten. Commit or stash first
agentPromptDiverged: Git sync failed. {branch} has diverged from {upstream}. Please rebase onto the latest origin and resolve any conflicts.
agentPromptRejected: Git push was rejected. There appear to be new commits on {upstream}. Please pull to merge, then push again.
agentPromptAuth: Git authentication failed. Please check the credential helper or SSH configuration and try again.
agentPromptNoUpstream: The {branch} branch has no upstream. Please push to origin and set up the tracking branch.
agentPromptLocalChanges: Git pull failed because local uncommitted changes would be overwritten by merge. Please stash or commit the changes, pull from {upstream}, and reapply the stash if you stashed.
agentPromptTimeout: Git sync timed out. Please check the network connection and retry.
agentPromptGeneric: Git sync failed. Please review the error below and resolve it.

commit.title: AI commit message
commit.description: Generate with Claude Code from staged, unstaged, and untracked changes, respecting Git ignore rules. Adopting the message automatically stages all listed changes and creates a local commit.
commit.subject: Commit title
commit.copyFailed: Copy failed. Please select and copy the message manually.
commit.replaceConfirm: Replace the existing message with a newly generated one?
commit.truncated: The changes exceed the AI input limit. Only part of the evidence was sent; review the message against all changed files before committing.

errors.changed: The repository, branch, HEAD, or working tree changes have changed. Generate again before committing.
errors.detached: Switch to a branch before committing.
errors.operation: A merge, rebase, cherry-pick, or revert is in progress. Complete it in the terminal first.
errors.conflicts: Resolve conflicts before generating or committing.
errors.locked: Another Git operation holds the index lock. Wait for it to finish and retry.
errors.invalidGeneration: The generated message is invalid. Please try again.
errors.commitFailed: Commit failed. Review the Git error below; resolve identity, signing, or hook issues before retrying.
errors.indexUpdateFailed: The commit was created, but the index could not be updated. Inspect git status in the terminal; do not repeat this commit.
errors.commitHookWarning: The commit was created, but Git reported an error afterward. Check the repository hooks; do not repeat this commit.
errors.generateTimeout: Die KI-Generierung hat das Zeitlimit überschritten. Die vorhandene Nachricht bleibt erhalten. Erneut generieren oder manuell bearbeiten.
errors.requestTimeout: Zeitlimit überschritten. Dialog schließen und erneut öffnen.
errors.requestFailed: Anfrage fehlgeschlagen oder ungültige Antwort. Bitte erneut versuchen.
errors.commitUnknown: Commit-Ergebnis unklar. Vor einem erneuten Versuch git log und git status im Terminal prüfen.
